phases.title: Contract / Policy / Safety Boundary
phases.narrowGoal: Start P136 with an implementation-grade secrets/provider/tool governance contract, seven-subphase split, safety boundary, checker, docs/status handoff, and planned-only P136.2 handoff.
phases.dataShape: Contract-only. Adds no secret values, secret stores, provider adapters, tool executors, model clients, budget ledgers, approval writers, dashboard source, Playwright source, DB/runtime writers, or live execution paths.

Do not create provider credentials, model clients, tool executors, budget ledgers, approval writers, deploy paths, release paths, export paths, or package paths in P136.1.

Do not expose raw private IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, secret references as primary identifiers, provider payloads, mutation controls, provider controls, tool execution controls, deploy controls, package controls, or spend controls in primary UX.
